_about: Sir Richard Winn Livingstone (1880-1960), Oxford classicist and educationist. Not David Livingstone (shelf david-livingstone). Raw IA OCR: The Greek Genius and its Meaning to Us (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1912); A Defence of Classical Education (Macmillan, 1916). His edited volumes (The Legacy of Greece, 1921; The Pageant of Greece, 1923) are multi-author or anthologies of others' translations and are not taken. US public domain. No uids minted.
